name: Key‑Safe Skill Generator (Zero-Exposure Edition)
description: A documentation‑only meta‑skill that teaches AI agents how to design, generate and validate zero‑exposure skills on MGC Blackbox 1.5.4. Provides the generation specification (credential layer, script layer, workflow package layer, sealed delivery layer), a selectable acceptance checklist, and corrected templates. Credentials are stored encrypted; local scripts read them via the localhost REST API at runtime, while AI agents never touch plaintext. Covers 1.5.4 dual-mode sealing, link authorization, capsule import, folder workflows with auto-recognised cross-script call graphs, and credential rotation and deletion.
author: MirginCipher Team

skills.name: credential_layer_spec
skills.description: Specification for the credential record of a generated skill: naming convention, content shape, runtime retrieval contract, rotation and revocation

skills.name: script_layer_spec
skills.description: Specification for the single-script shape of a generated skill: literal argparse defaults, ext02 runtime args, result-file contract, addressing rules and banned patterns

skills.name: workflow_package_spec
skills.description: Specification for the workflow package shape of a generated skill: folder structure, recognised cross-script call forms, diff_2 and diff_3 addressing, run-compatibility badge

parameters.diff_3: <relative POSIX path including the file extension>

skills.name: sealed_delivery_spec
skills.description: Specification for delivering a generated skill to another node: local, p2p and free mode selection, output_dir requirement, capsule import, link authorization and receiver version floor

links.upstream_skill: MGC Blackbox skill document, loadable live via the mgc_skill tool

provides: The generation specification for building zero-exposure skills on MGC Blackbox
Layer-level rules for credentials, scripts, workflow packages and sealed delivery
An acceptance checklist that makes a generated skill objectively verifiable
Templates whose runtime behaviour matches MGC 1.5.4
does_not_provide: Executable code of its own — this skill generates skills, it does not run them
Script generation on behalf of the user without review
Credential values — those stay in MGC, always
security.note: AI agents must NEVER call mgc_get on a credential entry. The only permitted mgc_get is the node public key lookup (info_type='__NODE_PUB__', info_owner='__NODE_PUB__'). Credentials are read by local scripts inside MGC blackbox execution via the localhost REST API; the AI only sees the operation result. Credentials are never sealed into a capsule and are removed with mgc_delete when revoked. MGC protects content confidentiality; after unsealing, a script runs with the permissions of the user running it and its runtime behaviour is outside MGC's control.
